title: Databricks Genie app for Slack is now generally available
body: The Databricks Genie app for Slack is now [generally available](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Send a direct message to the app or mention `@Genie` in a channel or group DM to get answers to data questions without leaving Slack. See [Databricks Genie app for Slack](/aws/en/genie-one/genie-slack).
